prompt: An antiproton is the anti-particle of the proton. It has the same mass as a proton, but has a charge of -1.60 x 10-19 C and is made of antimatter. Whenever matter and antimatter come into contact they will annihilate and convert 100% of their mass into energy. If 881 protons collided with an equal number of antiprotons, the total energy released would be _____ GeV.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] correctly treats the total rest-mass energy as (881+881) times the proton rest energy (~0.938 GeV) and computes 1762×0.938 ≈ 1652.756 GeV, rounding to about 1653. Candidate [3] uses the same overall approach but uses a slightly different proton rest energy (~0.939 GeV), yielding 1657.418 GeV, which is close but less accurate. Candidate [4] makes an arithmetic error in the final multiplication (producing 1645.974 GeV instead of about 1651 GeV). Candidate [2] has major unit/scaling mistakes and ends far from the correct value (~1462 GeV).
